protocol: Fresh model, seed 42; 10000 candidates, 15 epochs, batch size 64; checkpoint selected only by validation winner log-loss.
interpretation: Exploratory temporal evaluation. Test matches were previously used in the pilot experiment; no pilot weights are reused. This is not an independent confirmatory test.
limitations: Almost exclusively NA test; not evidence for other regions.
177 test matches are on patch 16.19, absent from training and validation.
Only winner metrics are evaluated; other output heads are not validated.
